name: plymouth
title: Plymouth boot splash
summary: boot splash that continues the GRUB theme

commands.apply: render the theme, install it and rebuild the initramfs (undone on any failure)
commands.preview: a still picture of the boot, password or shutdown screen
commands.build: render the theme into a directory, install nothing

menu: Render the theme and rebuild the initramfs

options.name: no-cmdline
options.summary: never edit the kernel command line (you add 'splash' yourself)

questions.title: Loading bar
questions.help: How the wavy loading bar behaves while the system starts.

options.label: Fills as the boot progresses
options.help: The bar fills up as the boot goes on.

questions.title: How much moves
questions.help: The turning shapes and cookies, the pulsing hero card and the running wave.

options.label: Full
options.help: Shapes and cookies turn and drift, the hero card pulses, the row cookie morphs, the wave runs.

options.label: Calm
options.help: The same, slower, without the pulse and the morph.

options.label: Still
options.help: Nothing moves (the bar still fills if you chose that).

questions.title: I will add 'splash' to the kernel command line myself
questions.help: Plymouth needs 'splash' on the kernel command line. By default the installer adds it for you (and puts it back on removal). Say Yes to have the installer never edit the kernel command line.
